mapper.sql: FROM customer c LEFT JOIN purchase pu ON pu.customer_id = c.customer_id LEFT JOIN product p ON p.product_id = pu.product_id LEFT JOIN supplier s ON s.supplier_id = pu.supplier_id
mapper.select:
SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, c.phone AS customer_phone, c.address AS customer_address, p.product_id AS purchased_product_id, p.product_name AS purchased_product_name, p.category AS purchased_product_category, p.unit_price AS purchased_product_price, s.supplier_id AS purchase_supplier_id, s.supplier_name AS purchase_supplier_name
ORDER BY c.customer_id, p.product_id, s.supplier_id

SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, c.phone AS customer_phone, c.address AS customer_address, p.product_id AS purchased_product_id, p.product_name AS purchased_product_name, p.category AS purchased_product_category, p.unit_price AS purchased_product_price, s.supplier_id AS purchase_supplier_id, s.supplier_name AS purchase_supplier_name
WHERE c.customer_id = #{customerId} ORDER BY p.product_id, s.supplier_id
